title: Magmanic: Magma Stuff
description: This is a mod that I made because I wanted more magma themed stuff to build/work with
body:
This mod adds lots of magma-themed building blocks, tools, weapons and mechanics.

To get started, simply go to the Nether and mine some magma blocks, you'll know when you got the new stuff.

The mod was made to be compatible with create, in the sense that it has multiple create processing recipes integrated for lots of magmatic mass production.
